Game Overview

The Smile Haunts You is a horror title where quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in The Smile Haunts You is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is The Smile Haunts You?

The Smile Haunts You is a free horror game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is The Smile Haunts You free to play?

Yes, The Smile Haunts You is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
